scope: Core foundation plus persisted typed attribute model API and application services; not complete MOD/AT-MOD requirements
profile: core / real Docker Linux arm64 / synthetic tenants and PostgreSQL17.11
command: docker compose --env-file .local/runtime.env -f deploy/compose/compose.yaml exec -T api pnpm test:integration

source_binding.method: SHA256 of each tested file read from the running API container and matched to worktree; commit binding pending

verified: Raw model-file duplicate-key rejection and structured issues
Immutable version export and definition import roundtrip
Exact large decimal preservation, typed errors and stale asset versions
Current canonical visibility rechecked before cached attribute response
Server preview digest becomes stale after asset edit
Compatible publication preserves existing pins and old definitions
Destructive schema publication blocked without explicit migration
Asset audit history excludes model events even for equal logical identifiers
Fresh service permission checks, complete visibility and cohort limits
Injected journal failure rolls back canonical data/revisions/head together
limitations: Browser journey and automated accessibility recorded separately after UI fixes.
Direct rollback tests inject a failing journal port; production HTTP tests use real audit/outbox.
Migration execution, inheritance/relations, every ingress, typed search/filter/sort and full model requirement coverage remain incomplete.
Serial tenant mutation locking is a development correctness profile; enterprise throughput is unmeasured.
No independent human security review or supported release qualification.
